decision: Go Deeper for component utility; Refine decay intervention; no promotion

dataset.rationale: 12 personas × 2 families × 20 seeds; 17 paired conditions; dependent simulation histories, not humans

limitations: Synthetic hidden state is not observed real mastery.
Component timing policies differ from the application planner.
Raw closed-loop BKT score is not an observation-space probability; primary estimator comparison is separate open-loop Brier.
fallback: Assessed-count remains the explicit comparison control; historical release unchanged.
